data.name: Artemis CP/M-80 compatibility / virtual peripheral bridge

specification.execution: Qualified Z80 binaries execute on the Z80 guest processor, not natively on the new host ISA; OS/memory/peripheral bridging remains required.
specification.peripheral_model: the ERA host exposes Artemis peripherals through a virtual peripheral bridge
specification.goal: preserve the Aurelia software investment while transitioning to the 32-bit platform
specification.api_discovery: Return the display/input/service capabilities actually implemented by the compatibility environment.

implementation_design.status: Accepted design baseline; implementation conformance and measured performance remain to be validated.
implementation_design.title: Z80 compatibility module and host driver
implementation_design.execution: Z80 executes the enhanced CP/M environment in its local 64 KB RAM; ERA executes the AIONix host driver. This is neither ERA execution of Z80 instructions nor a C-source port.
module_requirements: Local boot/system ROM or a host-uploaded system image
Bank/window emulation sufficient for documented Logix CP/M service entry points
A bounded shared mailbox or dual-ported transfer window and interrupt/doorbell signals; reserve its CP/M-side RAM before advertising TPA

software_split.guest: CP/M BIOS and Logix TUI/device stubs marshal requests; applications using these interfaces do not access Artemis registers.
software_split.host: A privileged AIONix driver validates guest buffer offsets and lengths, copies data and dispatches console/display, file, printer and clock operations.
software_split.ownership: Guest-visible drive images preserve CP/M semantics. Host filesystem translation is a separate explicit mode, not transparent raw-volume sharing.

implementation_design.scheduling: One outstanding synchronous guest request initially; host completes then signals the guest. Add polling fallback and timeout/reset recovery. Never allow a guest to supply an unchecked ERA pointer.
implementation_design.display: Render an isolated guest text surface through host display services. Capability queries describe that guest surface, not every ERA capability.
implementation_design.scope: Support documented enhanced CP/M/Logix API applications. Arbitrary direct Aurelia hardware access, undocumented mapper use, timing-sensitive code and unvirtualized expansion ROMs are not guaranteed.
implementation_design.qualification: Artemis PRO support remains unclaimed until its compatibility list and tests explicitly add the module.
